name: project-documentation
description: Repository documentation and reusable knowledge extraction with presentation, internal, audit, update, release, and Agent Skill documentation workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Extract and maintain reusable repository documentation
interface.longDescription: Creates and maintains GitHub-facing presentation documentation and detailed internal project knowledge, separates functional contracts from implementation, extracts reusable capabilities, audits documentation against source evidence, and documents Agent Skills and plugins.
defaultPrompt: Document this repository with a clear README and detailed internal project knowledge.
Audit this project's documentation against the current implementation.
Extract reusable capabilities from this repository for use in another project.
Document this Agent Skill repository for users and maintainers.
